count_semantics.raw_product_rows: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product; includes archived rows, test fixtures, and historical aliases.
count_semantics.active_rows: lifecycle_status = ACTIVE; not a canonical or production KPI by itself.
count_semantics.archived_rows: lifecycle_status = ARCHIVED; includes legitimate history and merged aliases.
count_semantics.merged_historical_aliases: archived_reason begins DUPLICATE_MERGED_TO_CANONICAL; not an independent product.
count_semantics.real_canonical_products: product rows excluding shared test-fixture authority and merged-alias lineage.
count_semantics.production_eligible_products: active real canonical rows with a non-empty identity and no external-ID contradiction; visual media readiness is measured separately.

guards: historical evidence list contains exactly 48 pairs
same authoritative platform product ID on both rows
title similarity >= 0.85 plus compatible size/variant tokens
duplicate lifecycle is ARCHIVED with exact canonical lineage marker
canonical survivor exists and is not a merged alias
all dependency tables have explicit policy
all product and dependency pre-images are tombstoned before delete
one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction with rollback on invariant failure
